title: Chicken Salad With Skordalia
ingredients: Chili powder or paprika to taste
directions: Soak bread in milk or stock. Put walnuts, garlic, salt, pepper, 2/3 cup cilantro and the chili powder or paprika in processor. Pulse to grind coarsely. Squeeze most of the liquid from bread. Add bread to container, along with oil. Process until combined and mixture has the consistency of mayonnaise. Bind chicken with sauce. Garnish with rest of cilantro.
